title: Snell to an unidentified correspondent, sympathetic-ink cipher, 1824 (HStAM 9 a Nr. 259 f. 249; HCPortal 513)

steps.what: Fetched HCPortal record 513 metadata and full-resolution image; scanned records 490-535 for siblings from Nr. 259 (none).
Transcribed the six cipher lines (169 signs) and the decipherer's Anmerkung from crops.
Anmerkung: key letters bcdefg written continuously over the cipher, plaintext at the table's left edge, pairs for the first word.
The pairs fit shifts +2..+7 for b..g in a 25-letter alphabet without j.
Continuous decryption: line 1 reads ('schiket lisching oder e?nen andern hierher'), later lines drift out of phase.
Per-line and per-word phase search: 'beantworte diese fragen', 'paul follen', 'america', 'fries oken', 'merkliche folgen' at shifted phases.
Beam decoder allowing phase slips, scored with the de-modern n-gram model.
'de 4ette' = de Wette: the digit 4 is w under g (21+7 = 28); the cipher columns run on past z into digits, which take key letters.
With digits counted, the phase is continuous except one omitted sign in 'wo nicht'; 9 words carry single-sign copy slips (g/q, r/v, u/n/w, one transposition).
HCPortal, web and GitHub search for a prior reading, Lisching, Snell and Wetzlar; only an unsuccessful attempt (NoAutopilot/cipher-lab) found.

validation.notes: periodic Vigenere (period 6): the key is six shifts, not a substitution table, so a test that refits one value per sign does not apply

outcome.method: key recovered based on adjacent plaintext
outcome.method_basis: The decipherer's note on the same leaf gives the key letters and the first word's seven cipher/plain pairs; the table (25 letters, shifts +2..+7, digit run-on past z) and the reading of the rest were rebuilt here.
outcome.fraction_read_source: decrypt.py over ct.txt: 169 cipher signs, all given a value; 158 decrypt as written, 11 after one-sign slip corrections
outcome.notes: Every word reads; the digit signs all fall where the run-on table predicts. 158 of 169 signs decrypt correctly as written; 11 copy slips and one omitted sign are corrected from the table and the word (listed in decrypt.py). Addressee in the heading not read; Lisching not identified.

credits.note: decipherer's note on the leaf giving key letters and first word

prior.where: The contemporary decipherer's note on the same leaf (method and first word). HCPortal: not solved. NoAutopilot/cipher-lab on GitHub: attempted, not read (PR 35, 27 Sept 2026).

human: Problem posed with /goal from the catalogue entry; no target-specific intervention.
